responseMessageContents.text:
You’re right. You already shared them securely, and I should not have kept asking you to repeat that.

The fault is the session handoff: the variables are saved, but this runtime isn’t receiving them. I’ll stop asking for credentials. I’ll continue with the code and production-safe audit work available here, and if GitHub/Render control remains unavailable I’ll treat it as a platform binding issue—not something you need to re-enter.
